titles.native: 化石ドロボウと恐竜石

description:
The dinosaur fantasy revolves around a 12-year-old named Yuta and Gobi — a moving fossil. The two embark on a journey with Yuta's friends to chase a fossil thief and find Gobi's stolen fossil mother.

(Source: Anime News Network)
